label: Diagram 11.2
caption: Diagram 11.2 Renovation of a thermal element from the inside
description:
This drawing is a perspective view of the interior of a room, looking towards a green back wall that has a central four-pane window. Two grey walls angle away to the left and right, each containing a tall, narrow window. The left part of the green back wall, below and beside the window, is filled with a diagonal hatch pattern.

Running text at the top reads: "For example, if plaster is being removed from the inner side of a wall, the area of the thermal element is the area of external wall as viewed from inside the room."

To the right of the view is a legend. The first entry shows a small square with diagonal hatching, labelled "Area of the thermal element being renovated". The second entry shows a plain green square, labelled "Total area of the thermal element". A green band along the bottom carries the caption "Diagram 11.2 Renovation of a thermal element from the inside". The hatched region in the room corresponds to the first legend entry, while the whole green wall corresponds to the second.
